title: 2nd trial reporter Lestari Wulandari
paragraphs: The second hearing of hate talks against the news reporter Sulut, Lestari Wulandari, has been held.

According to the charges, Lestari Wulandari published a report on the campaign speech of the mayor's candidate on April 1, 2026 the prosecutors judged to spread hatred against a particular group. Article 28 verse (2) ITE Act (The teaching of hatred based on SARA).
The trial was held at the Manado State Court on July 14, 2026, where the panel of judges delayed the trial until August 4, 2026.
In the matter of Wulandari Lestary, the attorney of Ratna Sari's law said the plea for the defense to have the judge replaced was rejected by the council.
Lestari Wulandari worked as a Sulut News reporter in Manado, where journalisty organizations rated this case could have a lesson in press freedom.
The D.A. will read the charges to the next trial.
